entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To track an order, press one. For returns or exchanges, press two. To speak with a representative, please stay on the line.
Ugh, finally. Representative.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. My order number is VF78-21-B4.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF78-21-B4. I see an order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 15 days ago. Is that correct?
That's the one. It's not tracking my heart rate correctly during workouts at all. I want to send it back.

I'm very sorry to hear the Pulse isn't meeting your expectations. We can definitely get that return started for you. Our **standard policy** gives you a full **90 days** from delivery to send an item back, so you've got **plenty of time**. **Don't worry**, I'll get a return label sent right to your email.
Oh, 90 days? Okay, that's good to know. I'm swamped this week. Just send me the label and I'll pack it up sometime next week.
Of course. Let me just generate that for you... Hold on one second. Hmm... you know what, I need to correct myself, and I deeply apologize.
Correct yourself? What are you talking about?

I am so sorry for the miscommunication. I was looking at the general policy for our apparel. For electronic devices like the VeloBand Pulse, the actual return window is 30 days from the date of delivery.
Are you kidding me? You just told me I had 90 days! I literally just planned my week around what you said! If I wait until next week like I said, I'd be past 30 days. Is this a joke?
I completely understand your frustration, and this is entirely my mistake. I gave you incorrect information, and I sincerely apologize for the confusion it's caused.
So now what? Am I just out of luck because you don't know your own policies?

No, not at all. Because I was the one who provided you with the wrong timeline, we will absolutely honor what I told you. I'm making an exception in your file right now to extend your return window to the 90 days I quoted.
Wait, really? You'll still give me the 90 days?

Yes, absolutely. This was our error, and we're going to make it right. I've just processed the exception. The pre-paid return label is on its way to your email now. You can ship it back anytime in the next couple of months. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
Wow. Okay. I was getting ready for a real headache. Thank you for fixing that. I really appreciate you honoring your word.
It's my pleasure, and again, my apologies for the mix-up. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
